svg.title: Same receptor, different responses
svg.desc: Three fictional concentration–response plots. With no other agonist, the full agonist approaches 100 units and the partial agonist 40 from a baseline of 10. A lower concentration of the full agonist also gives 40 but its curve continues upward. Without agonist, neutral antagonist stays at 10 while inverse agonist approaches 5. With a fixed reference agonist, increasing neutral antagonist reduces an elevated response toward 10. The middle plot uses a magnified response axis. Concentration is in invented relative units on a log scale from 0.01 to 1000; zero concentration is off the log axis. These curves are not receptor occupancy or clinical doses.

g.text: Zero is off the log axis • curves illustrative
